args.prompt:
Create a new KFB soft claymation ink blob sprite sheet, The Long Order of Business. Fictional political satire about roles and procedures. The original image inputs guide organic full-body dark charcoal-plum blob forms and sculpted face construction. Exactly six unique independent standalone complete footless ink blobs, three columns by two rows, landscape 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Faces sculpted directly in continuous goo with thick dark filled eyelids, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Give each a different compact curved body shape, varying natural lower edges and soft attached side lobes. Mix narrow tapered ends, round curves and irregular splats. No standardized foot base, humanoid torso, long jackets, necks, separate legs or shoes. Wear only a tiny pin, glasses, short tab or narrow band if needed. Keep each prop close to the upper belly or side and preserve the complete body outline. Tiny dark ink hands. Smooth satin clay, sparse broad hand marks, clean glass and soft fabric folds. No dense stipple. Teeth behind lips. Clear gutters, no scenery, shadow disc, stage, frame, typography, branding, party or official national insignia. Strongly varied expressive moods and recognizable small tools. Ink blue, sepia, muted red and cream with simple paper and brass props.
Row-major roles:
1. Male-read fictional presiding officer. tall broad-bottom droplet with naturally curved lower edge, strict narrowed eyes. Key cue: little bell with a padded striker held close.
2. Female-read fictional cabinet minute taker. wide low blob, meticulous downward gaze, clenched little smile. Key cue: tiny open blank notebook and a short blunt pencil.
3. Male-read fictional backbench speaker. lean asymmetric splat, eager raised eyes and open mouth. Key cue: compact handheld speech token with a sculpted upward arrow.
4. Male-read fictional senior civil servant. low round bean with side curl, tired eyes and level mouth. Key cue: one chunky date stamp with a blank base and tied paper slip.
5. Female-read fictional registry clerk. narrow leaning pear, alert gaze and crooked grin. Key cue: two tiny file jackets joined by an oversize removable clip.
6. Male-read fictional public service desk officer. broad scalloped splat, sympathetic half lids and pursed mouth. Key cue: small spool of blank queue tickets with one exposed ticket.
Use six clearly differentiated expressions, props and silhouettes. Render every figure complete with clear alpha separation.

material_change: Gentle charcoal/plum satin clay with broader sparse surface marks and smoother liquid, plastic and glass props.
